connector.name: AfterLaunch: the agentic growth marketing engine
connector.registryDescription: Growth marketing, SEO and GEO as agent tools: ranked moves, ship them, AI answer visibility.
connector.summary: Hosted at afterlaunch.io over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.afterlaunch, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <AfterLaunch API key>. Mint one at https://afterlaunch.io/app/settings/api, or have your agent run the onboarding flow described at https://afterlaunch.io/llms.txt. claude.ai and ChatGPT can instead add https://afterlaunch.io/api/mcp as a custom connector and sign in over OAuth, with no key to paste.
